```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

data <- readRDS("data/hki-city-bikes-usage-yearly.rds") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  arrange(year)

stations <- readRDS("data/hki-city-bike-stations.rds") |>
  filter(station != "") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

year_choices <- c("All", as.character(sort(unique(stations$year), decreasing = TRUE)))

aggregate_stations <- function(metric) {
  setNames(
    lapply(year_choices, function(yr) {
      d <- if (yr == "All") stations else stations |> filter(year == as.numeric(yr))
      d |>
        group_by(station) |>
        summarise(value = sum(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
        arrange(desc(value))
    }),
    year_choices
  )
}

rows_json <- function(named_list_of_dfs) {
  rows <- lapply(named_list_of_dfs, function(df) {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) unname(as.list(df[i, , drop = FALSE])))
  })
  jsonlite::toJSON(rows, auto_unbox = TRUE)
}

departures_by_year <- aggregate_stations("departures")
arrivals_by_year   <- aggregate_stations("arrivals")

departures_data <- departures_by_year[["All"]] |> rename(departures = value)
arrivals_data   <- arrivals_by_year[["All"]] |> rename(arrivals = value)

departures_json <- rows_json(departures_by_year)
arrivals_json   <- rows_json(arrivals_by_year)

year_choices_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(year_choices)

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a")
accent_color <- "#FCBC19"
```

## Row {height="550px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: bike-journeys-by-year
plot_ly(data,
        x = ~year,
        y = ~count,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
        marker = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 10,
                      line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3)),
        hovertext = ~paste0(year, ": ", format(round(count, 1), nsmall = 1),
                             "M bike journeys"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>City bike journeys by year</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "",
                 tickvals = data$year,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 range = c(min(data$year) - 0.4, max(data$year) + 0.6),
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Journeys (millions)",
                 titlefont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#1a1a1a"),
                 range = c(0, max(data$count) * 1.3),
                 dtick = 1,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin = list(t = 40, r = 30),
    annotations = lapply(1:nrow(data), function(i) {
      list(
        x = data$year[i],
        y = data$count[i],
        text = paste0("<b>", format(round(data$count[i], 1), nsmall = 1), "</b>M"),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        yshift = 10,
        font = list(color = "#1a1a1a", size = 12, family = "Inter, sans-serif")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Row {height="500px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: top-departure-stations
#| title: "Most popular departure stations"
datatable(departures_data,
          colnames = c("Station" = "station", "Departures" = "departures"),
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10,
            lengthChange = FALSE,
            dom = "tip",
            scrollY = "300px",
            scrollCollapse = TRUE,
            language = list(info = "_TOTAL_ entries")
          )) |>
  formatCurrency("Departures", currency = "", interval = 3, mark = " ", digits = 0) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste0("
    function(el) {
      var run = function() { attachTableYearFilter(el, ", departures_json, ", ", year_choices_json, "); };
      if (window.attachTableYearFilter) run(); else window.addEventListener('load', run);
    }
  "))
```
